alerts.headline: Freeze Warning issued October 15 at 9:44AM MDT until October 16 at 10:00AM MDT by NWS Grand Junction CO
alerts.description:
* WHAT...For the first Freeze Warning, sub-freezing temperatures as
low as 24 expected. For the second Freeze Warning, sub-freezing
temperatures as low as 27 expected.

* WHERE...Central Yampa River Basin, Lower Yampa River Basin, Upper
Yampa River Basin, San Juan River Basin, and Central Colorado River
Basin.

* WHEN...For the first Freeze Warning, from midnight tonight to 10 AM
MDT Friday. For the second Freeze Warning, from midnight Friday
Night to 10 AM MDT Saturday.

* IMPACTS...Frost and freeze conditions could kill crops, other
sensitive vegetation and possibly damage unprotected outdoor
plumbing.

alerts.title: Traction Law Code 15
alerts.description: Between Exit 203: East Frisco (Silverthorne) and Exit 221: Bakerville (4 miles west of the Silver Plume area) from Mile Point 205 to Mile Point 221. Passenger vehicles that are all-wheel drive (AWD) or four-wheel drive (4WD) must have winter (Mountain Snowflake icon) or mud and snow (M+S or M/S) or manufacturer rated all-weather tires with adequate tread depth of at least 3/16 of an inch. Two-wheel drive (2WD) vehicles are required to have chains or an approved traction device.

alerts.title: Paving Operations-149375
alerts.description: Between Exit 140: US 6; Gypsum and US 6 (near Eagle) from Mile Point 146.25 to Mile Point 147.6. Right shoulder closed due to paving operations. Starting October 15, 2026 at 9:00PM MDT until October 16, 2026 at about 5:00AM MDT. Full schedule below: • October 15, 9:00PM - October 16, 5:00AM Comment: Eastbound and westbound staggered I-70 Eagle (Exit 147) on/off ramp closures. Eastbound off-ramp: Use Gypsum (Exit 140) and US 6 east to Eagle. Eastbound on-ramp: Use US 6 east to Wolcott (Exit 157) to access I-70 eastbound. Westbound off-ramp: Use Wolcott (Exit 157) and US 6 west to Eagle. Westbound on-ramp: Use US 6 west to Gypsum (Exit 140) to access I-70 westbound.

alerts.title: I-70 Glenwood Canyon Bridge Joint Improvements-148509
alerts.description: Between Exit 125: Hanging Lake and Exit 129: Bair Ranch (4 to 5 miles west of the Dotsero area) from Mile Point 127 to Mile Point 128. The right lane is closed due to bridge construction. Until today at about 7:01PM MDT. Full schedule below: • October 15, 7:00AM - October 15, 7:01PM Comment: Eastbound and westbound lane width restrictions, for commercial and recreational vehicles, are in effect 24 hours a day, 7 days a week. A commercial and recreational vehicle width limit of 11'-0" is in place for the duration of the project. Eastbound I-70 will be reduced to one lane from Mile Point 127 to 128. Westbound from Mile Point 125 to 126 on the east side of Hanging Lake Tunnel will be one-lane for bridge joint water testing. Daytime work hours will be 7 a.m. to 7 p.m., Monday through Friday. The speed limit will be reduced to 35 mph through the work zone.
